# Iron Never Changes

> Iron Never Changes is a heavyweight gym wear brand for men with jobs, kids and a bar in their week. Garment-dyed cotton tees, screen printed in one color of ink. The name finishes as "Iron never changes. You do." House slogan: "Where limits meet defeat."

Status: the shop opens with Drop 001. The site shows the full line with prices; nothing is on sale yet, and there are no preorders.

## The line

- 24 shirts in four washes (washed black, blue, grey and brown), sizes S to 3XL, $34 to $42.
- Heavyweight, garment-dyed, screen printed, so the print cracks and fades with wear. No tech fabric, no neon.
- Designs come from the brand's slogan bank: "I didn't feel like it either", "Rock bottom has a squat rack", "45 minutes that belong to me", "The bar doesn't know you're tired", "Come back tomorrow" and more.
- [The Shop](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#shop): every shirt, front and back, with its print spec and price.

## Coaching

- [The Corner](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#corner): coaching with Zac, $100 a month, month to month. Meal plans from real groceries, lifting programs built around your schedule, unlimited talk and text, video form checks, monthly progress tracking. Coaching opens alongside Drop 001.
